newsitem.title: UK: LEP in Saudi UK book forwarding deal.
newsitem.headline: LEP in Saudi UK book forwarding deal.

text.p: LEP International and its partner in Saudi Arabia, Globe Marine Services, have been appointed sole forwarder and freight handler for the substantial volumes of books which the Saudi-based, Jarir Bookstore is purchasing in the UK.

LEP said in a statement that Jarir is a leading Saudi bookseller and the English-language books have been ordered from between 100 to 150 publishers. They range from medical books and detective titles to educational publications, including books for children.
The books are delivered to LEP's warehouse at Luton, where they are assembled for shipment, either by airfreight or seafreight depending on Jarir's delivery requirements.
Airfreight shipments are routed to Riyadh airport, while those for seafreight go to Riyadh dryport via the port of Dammam, the statement added.
